lessons_used: Sign-in & account: Post-adoption sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; moving sign-in post-waiting hurt, while account sync hints and safety notices showed no clear effect.

Path selection: Headline updates (clarity and value proposition), spotlight layouts, and visual story stage redesigns won; checklist layouts and story scroll redesigns hurt, while hints and copy simplifications showed no clear effect.

Waiting room: Interactive waiting rooms, desktop visibility/readiness status checks, and spawn location hints won; progress trackers, timers, sound notifications, and compatibility screens showed no clear effect.

Adoption flow: Split photo upload previews with quality guides won; compact grids, guidelines banners, stamp redesigns, and fallback or multi-step inspection flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews, incentives, and layout customizations showed no clear effect.

Finish & placement: Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome redesigns, docking hints, and retrieval callouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions accuracy: Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive flow wins (such as placement verification screens and spawn placement flows) and overpredicted gains on severe flow failures (such as stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, multi-step inspection, and guided spawn stages).

lessons_next: Post-adoption sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; moving sign-in pre-photo or post-waiting hurt or had no clear effect, while safety and sync hints showed no clear effect.

Path selection clarity/value headlines, spotlight layouts, and visual story redesigns won; checklist layouts, scroll redesigns, and reassurance notes hurt, while simplified copy showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints won; completion timers, progress trackers, sound alerts, and compatibility checks showed no clear effect.

Split photo upload preview layouts won; compact grids, guidelines banners, mascot stamp redesigns, and multi-step inspection flows hurt adoption, while pre-adoption reviews and incentives showed no clear effect.

Interactive spawn placement flows, placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while docking hints and welcome redesigns showed no clear effect.

Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive flow additions (such as placement verification screens and spawn placement flows) and overpredicted gains on severe flow failures (such as stamp redesigns, multi-step inspection, and guided spawn stages).
